rationale: Pulp's JavaScript bridge delivers one native pointer event through separate target and ancestor evaluate calls. Direct @pulp/react synthetic-event cancellation therefore needs a scoped internal token spanning that Pulp-specific bridge walk; without it, stopPropagation is discarded and native ancestor callbacks still fire. This change adds no public View or MouseEvent API and is Pulp-only React/web-compat integration rather than generic Vellum framework behavior.
